description: Vigil Labs is a Palo Alto applied research lab building machine-intelligence systems for live markets, starting with tools that help traders detect, surface and forecast market-moving developments, with the long-term aim of a market prediction engine.
investors: Nova Global; Lux Capital; Pantera Capital; SV Angel; Soma Capital; Valor Equity Partners

description: Village is an agentic research workspace for hedge fund analysts: AI coding agents find and collect alternative data (web, hiring, satellite imagery, permits, filings), build monitors and dashboards, backtest ideas and send alerts when signals change.
investors: Neo

description: New York consumer app (YC Fall 2026) pitched as 'a hedge fund on your desk': AI agents value public companies, track the filings of well-known investors and members of Congress, and turn a user's views into rule-based portfolios to backtest and follow on paper or with real money.
investors: Y Combinator; Afore Capital; a16z Scout Fund

description: Wissen produces AI-generated fundamental research on listed companies (twelve research modules rebuilt after each results release), continuously monitors filings, competitors, policy and alternative data via ranked watchpoints, and sends a weekly digest, via a portal and MCP.

Wokelo is an AI agent platform for private equity, investment banking, venture capital, consulting and corporate development teams that automates deal sourcing, due diligence, sector research and portfolio monitoring using a database of 20M+ companies.
investors: KPMG Ventures; Array Ventures; Geek Ventures; Rebellion Ventures; Ahead VC; Perpetual Venture Capital; Untapped Capital; SeaChange Fund; Pack Ventures; Upsparks Capital; Breakwater Ventures; Early Stage Quant Fund

description: Zanista AI's NewsWitch uses LLMs to turn about 1M news articles a day into structured, sentiment-labeled metadata (history back to 2000), delivered via API and dashboards to traders, hedge funds and quant researchers. The London firm also sells AI exam-grading tools.

AI associates for middle-market private equity firms and investment banks (YC F25). Its agents screen teasers against a firm's thesis, redline NDAs, log calls and emails into CRMs such as DealCloud and Salesforce, and prepare pre-call briefs inside Outlook and Teams.
investors: Y Combinator

description: ZeroWallStreet is a chat-based AI investing assistant with agents for stock research (10-K/10-Q filings and company news), ETFs, news analysis, portfolio discussion and company comparisons, including a mode for beginners.

Zillion provides AI analysts for investment firms that pull data on 12,000+ issuers and 40+ economic datasets, analyze documents, and generate spreadsheets, financial models such as DCFs and LBOs, PowerPoints and charts.

New York AI lab (YC S24) that trains general quantitative forecasting models, using LLMs in multi-agent optimization loops to automate the model build-test-improve cycle. For now it deploys the models in algorithmic trading with its own capital.
investors: Y Combinator; Pioneer Fund

description: Zoonova is a stock research platform whose natural-language AI command center serves its ensemble machine-learning price and alpha forecasts, news sentiment scores and chart-pattern scans, plus tear sheets, risk analysis and backtesting.
